svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the lid with the template (TBK-DWG-103) clamped on it as a guide.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Twelve 36 mm holes for the heater wells: six on a 150 mm radius at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 0, 60, 120 ... degrees and six on a 245 mm radius at the same angles.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Twelve 48 mm holes for the U-tube legs: six on 80 mm and six on 235 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 6 mm holes for the sand thermocouples (lid layout picture).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut with bi-metal hole saws at low speed with cutting oil; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark a line at 0 degrees on the lid and the drum rim to line them up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the lid drops over all 24 pipe ends, the well holes leaving a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4.6 mm gap (a T1 to T3 sheath fits beside its well) and the leg holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2.9 mm. An AES rope collar is laid round every pipe on the lid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the template on the lid; every hole lines up.
